concerns.text: Task T015 expects `data/timing.csv` and `data/memory.csv` to exist, but no prior task creates these files. Consequently SC‑003 (measure total compute time and peak memory) cannot be satisfied, making the performance‑summary deliverable untestable.

The constitution (Principle V) requires every artifact change to update `state/projects/PROJ-239-evaluating-the-statistical-significance-.yaml` with content hashes. No task in the list writes to or updates this state file, violating the version‑tracking requirement.
